physical_assumptions.optics_model: Finite planar specular mirror array with image-source virtual emitters and receiver effective entrance aperture clipping
physical_assumptions.dc_approximation: Direct-current / low-frequency approximation, symbol duration >> propagation delay, negligible delay dispersion and ISI
physical_assumptions.incoherent_im_dd: Intensity modulation with direct detection; scalar optical power addition, no RF complex phase shifts
physical_assumptions.lambertian_source: Co-located Lambertian LED emitters per fixture, downward optical axis [0, 0, -1]
physical_assumptions.no_diffraction: Geometric optics approximation without wave diffraction
physical_assumptions.no_diffuse_scattering: Specular mirror reflection only; diffuse wall reflections ignored
physical_assumptions.no_blockage: Unobstructed line of sight between sources, mirrors, and receivers
physical_assumptions.power_conservation: Collected tile optical power strictly bounded by incident intercepted optical power multiplied by reflectivity
physical_assumptions.shared_normals: Physical mirror normals are fixed per codebook state and shared across all transmitters and receivers
physical_assumptions.off_state: Configuration 0 is an inactive/stowed zero-reflection reference state with exact zero gain
physical_assumptions.fov_enforcement: Receiver field of view strictly enforced at all integration sample points; rays exceeding FoV yield zero gain

ris.CSI_assumption: Scenario geometry known exactly; codebook target positions are oracle simulation inputs
ris.channel_assumption: Single-bounce scalar optical gains; no RIS delay/ISI or blockage added
